ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $\sin B= \frac{5}{13}$, D is on side $BC$, and $\angle ADC=45^\circ$, $AC=5$. Find the tangent value of $\angle BAD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle C=90^\circ$ and $\angle ADC=45^\circ$ with $AC=5$,\\
it follows that $AC=CD=5$ and $AD=5\sqrt{2}$,\\
Since $\sin B= \frac{5}{13}$,\\
then $AB=\frac{AC}{\sin B}=13$,\\
Since $\angle C=90^\circ$ and $CD=5$,\\
then $BC=12$ and $BD=7$,\\
Draw $BE\perp AD$ to extend $AD$ at $E$,\\
Since $\angle BDE=\angle ADC=45^\circ$,\\
it follows that $BE=DE=\frac{7}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{7\sqrt{2}}{2}$,\\
Therefore, $AE=AD+DE=5\sqrt{2}+\frac{7\sqrt{2}}{2}=\frac{17\sqrt{2}}{2}$,\\
Thus, $\tan \angle BAD = \boxed{\frac{7}{17}}$.
